chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her fifties wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba with a white floral headscarf
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her twenties wearing a deep burgundy long cardigan over a black dress, long dark wavy hair loose, gold hoop earrings
chars.NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan man around 28 with short black hair and trimmed beard, wearing a light grey hoodie and dark jeans
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan teenage girl with a high ponytail wearing a mint-green tracksuit

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan family living room with sedari couches and a tea tray, MOM sits and stares suspiciously and strangely at WIFE, who sits across from her looking uneasy, avoiding her eyes. Both clearly visible in the center.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: MOM stands at the doorway to the kitchen waving WIFE to come with her, WIFE stands up hesitantly; NARRATOR sits on the couch next to an older man, watching curiously.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan kitchen with blue tiles: SISTER walks in to help, MOM and WIFE stand near the counter, MOM pulling the kitchen door half closed with a serious face.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR in the hallway of a Moroccan home leans his ear against the closed kitchen door, eyes wide, listening secretly, a little comic expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the Moroccan kitchen: MOM faces WIFE with arms crossed, asking a pointed question, WIFE looks shocked and nervous, holding a tea glass.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan kitchen: MOM and WIFE both raising their voices emotionally, WIFE with tears starting, MOM gesturing with her hand, tense dramatic moment.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR pushes open the kitchen door and finds MOM and WIFE both crying, SISTER standing confused between them, NARRATOR looks totally lost.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of NARRATOR in the kitchen doorway of a Moroccan home, arms open, confused and worried face, as if asking 'what is going on?'.
